'''Besany Wennen's apartment''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="tc">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>

When she began a relationship with [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|Null-ARC]] [[Ordo Skirata]], he started spending some occasional nights there.<ref name="tc" /> She fled from her apartment during the final days of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone wars]] and joined [[Kal Skirata]]'s [[Clan Skirata|clan]] in escaping to the planet [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].<ref name="o66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>
